method: Every EV id cited anywhere in packs/support-operations/ was read back from registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched and no licence was inferred: licence_state is derived from the ledger row's own licence text and from whether that row carries a licence_evidence line. Carried expression was checked by reading the pack's read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides, refs, exemplars) and by scanning every quoted span in it.

carried_expression.note: One quoted span of six words or more in the read surface, a suggested customer reply the pack wrote itself in GD-SUPPORT-002. The two paywalled ISO standards are paraphrased only and nothing from either is quoted, which is what their rows require.
